name: dovi_tool and hdr10plus_tool
role: Rust CLIs for Dolby Vision RPU and HDR10+ dynamic metadata in HEVC streams
notes: 2026-11-04: Triage: Concrete metadata inspection and editing gap beyond FFmpeg and MediaInfo HDR signalling; revisit after official automation route and profile coverage are checked.
documentation_status uses legacy listed-in-prd value for a listed-only discovery candidate; this is not evidence of PRD inclusion.

2026-11-24: Guide written from examples/dovi-tool-metadata-roundtrip (partial; dovi_tool 2.3.4, hdr10plus_tool 1.7.2, macOS arm64, synthetic metadata on 48-frame x265 10-bit HEVC). Metadata plumbing only, not playback or grading. L1 avg_pq/min_pq did not read back as written and info -s shows no sub-profile; everything else untested.

evidence.result: Partial: 9 of 11 predeclared checks pass. Profile-8 RPU generated, injected and extracted: 48 frames, extracted RPU byte-identical, decoded pixels identical to base, testsrc2 visibly intact. Fails: profile reads 8 not 8.1; per-frame L1 avg_pq reads 819 for frames 0-31 (predeclared 300, 650) and min_pq 12 for frames 32-47 (predeclared 20). hdr10plus_tool profile-A inject and extract of 48 frames matches predeclared values. FFmpeg 9.0.2 with libx265 4.3, Node v22.19.0.
evidence.scope: Synthetic RPU and HDR10+ metadata injected into x265 10-bit HEVC: stream, pixels and HDR10+ read back; DV profile and L1 avg/min differ; macOS arm64

summary: Native Rust command line tools for extracting, editing, generating and injecting Dolby Vision RPU or HDR10+ metadata in HEVC streams. Use them for metadata operations where FFmpeg probing alone is insufficient; they do not encode video.
use_when: Extract, inspect or modify Dolby Vision RPU or HDR10+ metadata in HEVC streams
Generate dynamic metadata when stream metadata work must remain separate from encoding
avoid_when: Use FFmpeg for decoding, filtering or encoding rather than dynamic metadata edits
Use MediaInfo for a broad read-only technical report

assessment.version_seen: dovi_tool 2.3.3; hdr10plus_tool latest release not verified
assessment.rationale: dovi_tool 2.3.3 released 2026-07-12 with export/editor fixes and libdovi updates; paired HDR10+ utility has separate release history. Native CLI route and macOS binary are documented.
